compute_llvm_checksums: compute checksums for an LLVM source checkout directory using SHA-256 hashing
write_llvm_checksums: write project checksums to a file in the format of hash followed by project name
read_llvm_checksums: read checksums from a reference file and return a dictionary mapping project names to hashes
validate_checksums: validate that new checksums match reference checksums with optional missing project tolerance
run_llvm_checksum_cli: run the llvm_checksum CLI to compute or verify checksums of an LLVM checkout directory
